title: 零度の境界、夜明けの調べ
author: 夜野しずく

en.title: Zero-Temperature Boundary, Dawn's Melody
en.premise: A girl who locks herself away in her own "ice castle", keeping it off-limits to anyone else. The only window she has is the faint sound of a small radio that plays at dawn. One morning, she discovers that the voice belongs to a boy sitting next to her. In the freezing season, their distance slowly draws closer, melting like light.

zh.title: 零度边界，黎明之曲
zh.premise: 一个女孩把自己封闭在独自的“冰城”里，绝不让任何人触碰。她唯一的窗户是黎明时分小小收音机里流淌的声音。某个清晨，她发现那声音的主人正是坐在旁边的少年。在寒冷的季节里，两人的距离慢慢靠近，像光一样融化。
